title: Satu Mendatar, Dua Menegak
subject: a woman who rides the KL Monorail from end to end every Sunday morning with a pencil, solving one page of a Malay crossword book per round trip
caption: Malay liquid drum and bass. Rolling two-step breakbeat with crisp ghost snares, deep round sub bass, Rhodes electric piano chords, airy string pad, muted guitar plucks in the breakdown. Clean spacious modern mix with soft sidechained pads. Female soprano, light and clear, sung in unhurried half-time phrasing over the fast drums. 174 BPM, F# minor. Light, breezy and gently playful. No autotune, no trap hi-hats, no dubstep wobble, no rap, no dangdut.
lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes and string pad, breakbeat fades in]

[Verse 1]
Ahad pagi, tren masih kosong
Pensel dua, pemadam satu
Monorel goyang perlahan
Saya buka muka seratus

[Pre-Chorus]
Stesen Titiwangsa
Petunjuk pertama

[Chorus]
Satu mendatar, dua menegak
Bandar lalu kat tingkap
Satu pusingan, satu muka
Habis dulu, baru balik

[Verse 2]
Pakcik sebelah tolong teka
Lima huruf, nama buah
Dia jawab betik, betul
Dia turun di Bukit Bintang

[Chorus]
Satu mendatar, dua menegak
Bandar lalu kat tingkap
Tujuh menegak masih kosong
Minggu depan saya sambung

[Outro - breakbeat drops out, Rhodes alone]
